studies.notes: The saved source is the accepted manuscript dated March 9th, 2024, not the journal copy of record (PDF p. 1); PDF and printed page numbers agree. The complete markdown conversion was read through Appendix 1 (PDF p. 40); the extraction names no separate supplement. Only analyzed arm sizes are printed. No combined analyzed participant count is printed in the manuscript, tables, figures, or appendix, so n_analyzed remains null; the total in the screening form is not copied or calculated from the arms. The same sample is used for the PIT quality, elaboration, and originality comparisons and ANCOVAs (PDF p. 16), including the originality ANCOVA identified as main in the extraction notes, and the group-by-task originality analysis (PDF p. 17). No different analysis-specific participant counts are printed. PDF p. 10, Experimental Procedure, states: "All the participants passed the attention checks and completed all the required tasks. Therefore, no participants were excluded." Random assignment occurred before the experiment, but the paper prints no count at assignment or enrollment and does not establish whether every assigned volunteer attended. Study-level and arm-level n_randomized therefore remain null. No count was inferred from degrees of freedom, outputs, ratings, or arithmetic on other counts.
